d:
Bihar ke madhubni men huee ganbhir ghatna par rashtriy janta dal (RJD) ke rajyasbha sansad manoj jha ne rajy sarkar aur kendr par jordar hamla bola hai.
Manoj jha ne jankari dete hue bataya ki neta pratipaksh tejasvi yadav (jo telangana ke sadar mahotsav men shamil hone haidrabad gae the) vahan se sidhe ghatna sthal yani madhubni ke lie ravana ho rahe hain.
